none: PAS PAS-190848: Roman silver finger-ring fragment
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment, silver finger-ring. Broken flat rectangular bezel. Hoop is slightly angular at shoulder, beginning to curve but broken. Inscribed in capital letters on the flattened part of the hoop forming a bezel. [...].ITA. [...].IAT.
